name: @activepieces/piece-personal-ai
description: Manage memory storage, messaging, and documents through AI integration.

create_memory.name: create_memory
create_memory.description: Upload memories to your AI assistant stack.

text.description: Plain text memories to upload to your stack

sourceName.description: The source or application of memory to help you recall where it is from

createdTime.description: Time (including timezone) of the memory (e.g., Wed, 19 Sep 2023 13:31:00 PDT)

rawFeedText.description: The formatted text that can be stored as it is

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI persona

tags.description: Comma delimited list of tags for the memory

aiMetadata.description: Append a plain-text memory to the Personal AI memory stack so the assistant can recall it later, tagging it with a required source name and optional tags/domain/timestamp. Use when you want to persist a fact or note for future retrieval. Each call adds a new memory entry, so it is not idempotent.

create_message.name: create_message
create_message.description: Send a message to the AI assistant for a response.

text.description: Message to send to your AI for a response

context.description: Additional context for the AI response (Similar to Reply function)

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

userName.description: Name of the user sending the request

sessionId.description: Use the same sessionId to continue conversation on that session

sourceName.description: Name of the source app of the inbound message

isStack.description: Flag to also add the user message to memory

isDraft.description: Flag to create a copilot message for the AI

aiMetadata.description: Send a message to the Personal AI assistant and get its generated reply, optionally continuing an existing conversation by reusing the same session ID. Use when you want a conversational answer from the assistant; set the add-to-memory flag to also persist the message. Each call produces a fresh response, so it is not idempotent.

create_chatgpt_instruction.name: create_chatgpt_instruction
create_chatgpt_instruction.description: Send an instruction to AI assistant using ChatGPT integration.

text.description: The instruction or prompt to send to ChatGPT

context.description: Additional context for the AI response

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

userName.description: Name of the user sending the request

sessionId.description: Use the same sessionId to continue conversation on that session

sourceName.description: Name of the source app of the inbound instruction

isStack.description: Flag to also add the user instruction to memory

isDraft.description: Flag to create a copilot message for the AI

aiMetadata.description: Send an instruction or prompt to the Personal AI assistant routed through its ChatGPT integration and get the generated response, optionally continuing a session by reusing the same session ID. Use when you want a ChatGPT-backed answer rather than the standard message flow. Each call generates a fresh response, so it is not idempotent.

create_custom_training.name: create_custom_training
create_custom_training.description: Send a custom training instruction to AI assistant.

text.description: The training instruction or prompt to send

context.description: Additional context for the AI response

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

userName.description: Name of the user sending the request

sessionId.description: Use the same sessionId to continue conversation on that session

sourceName.description: Name of the source app of the inbound training

isStack.description: Flag to also add the training instruction to memory

isDraft.description: Flag to create a copilot message for the AI

aiMetadata.description: Send a custom training instruction or prompt to the Personal AI assistant to shape its future behavior, optionally tied to a session. Use when you want to teach or fine-tune how the assistant responds rather than just chat with it. Each call submits a new training instruction, so it is not idempotent.

get_conversation.name: get_conversation
get_conversation.description: Retrieve conversation history from AI assistant.

channelId.description: The unique identifier for the conversation channel

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

userName.description: Name of the user requesting the conversation

sessionId.description: Filter conversation by specific session ID

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return

skip.description: Number of messages to skip (for pagination)

aiMetadata.description: Retrieve the message history for a conversation channel from the Personal AI assistant, with optional filtering by session/source and limit/skip pagination. Use when you need to read past messages rather than send a new one. The required channel ID identifies the conversation; this is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.

upload_document.name: upload_document
upload_document.description: Upload a text document to AI assistant.

text.description: The text content of the document to upload

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

tags.description: Comma delimited list of tags for the document

sourceName.description: Name of the source or application

createdTime.description: Time (including timezone) of the document creation (e.g., Wed, 19 Sep 2023 13:31:00 PDT)

isStack.description: Flag to also add the document to memory

aiMetadata.description: Upload a text document (raw text plus a title) to the Personal AI assistant so it can reference the content, with optional tags, source, and add-to-memory flag. Use when the source is plain text already in hand; use Upload File for binary files or Upload URL Content to fetch from a link. Each call creates a new document, so it is not idempotent.

upload_file.name: upload_file
upload_file.description: Upload a file to AI assistant.

fileName.description: Name of the file to be uploaded

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

tags.description: Comma delimited list of tags for the file

sourceName.description: Name of the source or application

createdTime.description: Time (including timezone) of the file creation (e.g., Wed, 19 Sep 2023 13:31:00 PDT)

isStack.description: Flag to also add the file content to memory

aiMetadata.description: Upload a binary file (sent as multipart form data) to the Personal AI assistant so it can reference the content, with optional tags, source, and add-to-memory flag. Use when the source is an actual file; use Upload Document for plain text or Upload URL Content to fetch from a link. Each call creates a new uploaded file, so it is not idempotent.

upload_url.name: upload_url
upload_url.description: Upload content from a URL to AI assistant.

url.description: The URL of the content to upload

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

tags.description: Comma delimited list of tags for the content

sourceName.description: Name of the source or application

createdTime.description: Time (including timezone) of the content creation (e.g., Wed, 19 Sep 2023 13:31:00 PDT)

isStack.description: Flag to also add the content to memory

aiMetadata.description: Fetch the content at a given URL and upload it to the Personal AI assistant under a title, with optional tags, source, and add-to-memory flag. Use when the source is a web link; use Upload Document for plain text or Upload File for binary files in hand. Each call creates a new entry, so it is not idempotent.

update_document.name: update_document
update_document.description: Update an existing document in AI assistant.

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to update

text.description: The updated text content of the document

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

tags.description: Comma delimited list of tags for the document

sourceName.description: Name of the source or application

createdTime.description: Time (including timezone) of the document creation (e.g., Wed, 19 Sep 2023 13:31:00 PDT)

isStack.description: Flag to also add the document to memory

aiMetadata.description: Overwrite an existing Personal AI document, identified by its document ID, with new text and optional title/tags/source. Use when you need to revise a known document rather than create a new one; the document ID must already exist. Because it replaces the document keyed on a stable ID, repeating the same call yields the same result and is idempotent.

get_document.name: get_document
get_document.description: Retrieve a document from AI assistant.

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to retrieve

domainName.description: The domain identifier for the AI profile

includeContent.description: Flag to include the document content in the response

aiMetadata.description: Fetch a single Personal AI document by its document ID, optionally including the full content. Use when you need to read back a previously uploaded document. The document ID is required; this is a read-only lookup and is idempotent.
